pages.text: The $(l)Warden$() below, the $(l)Elder Guardian$() beneath the sea, the $(l)Wither$() and the $(l)Dragon$(). None of them served the Sovereigns. Each keeps a relic of the world before.
Under the desert sleeps something older still: the $(#cc3333)Ancient Remnant$(). Ossukage calls himself the first Remnant. The desert disagrees.
